text: Mastermind, please pay attention to the real-time nature of this AI V3 dashboard. It doesn't seem to be updating very quickly. I want to see this thing flowing, flying fast. So the assistant skill, which might need to be reloaded if it's been refreshed, needs to be involved. However that assistant skill works, we want this real-time dashboard. I want to see everything happen instantly as it's happening. Let's cut to that chase so that I can see what you're working on. We do have to be careful we don't break anything with errors. So that system should just be a pure streaming log. Nothing breaks. It's append only. It just adds a new item to the log. That item gets pulled through to the browser instantly. And it gets rendered instantly. And the log data can transform existing UI as well as create new UI. So it's not just append only. We need the log to be able to change existing cards and append to them and transform them or whatever. Also we want a timeline grid. I've asked for this before. There should be a timeline grid. By the way, if there's any things on hold waiting on me, there shouldn't be. I thought we've talked about this a million times. The mastermind should know not to wait for my decision for things. Pick a sensible default and just go with it unless it's a dangerous operation. If there's something dangerous or potentially destructive, there's very few decisions that should actually be a roadblock, something you can't just make a quick decision and keep going with. Also it looks like there's a lot of console errors. I don't know if we have that monitor minion up. Let's focus on this AI V3 page, have somebody running Playwright or whatever and inspecting the console. All the errors should be relayed immediately to the minions working on them. I'm not sure what the mastermind skill says about how to manage concurrency. I don't know if you often have two minions working on one page, because that could be tricky. The mastermind shouldn't be assigning two minions to work on the same page, or at least have them work in sequence: ask one minion to do one thing and wait till it's done before you ask another minion to work on the same page. So I'm not sure what is breaking here. There's still a lot of console errors. We have cards of random widths.
